title: Toolchain Tool Manifest
description: Manifest contract for tools participating in a Toolchain-Family toolchain. Aligned with the Toolchain Tool Manager (TTM) manifest contract: a tool serves this file at <url>/manifest.json with CORS enabled, and TTM fetches it to register the tool and map its roles onto DocPouch data structures.

tool.description: Unique tool identifier / display name (e.g. 'swot', 'Ranker'). Pre-fills the tool name in TTM.

version.description: Tool version, informational. Use a stable, bumpable string (e.g. semver '1.0.0').

matchBy.description: Matching strategy hint. Accepted by TTM, currently unused. Tools in the family use 'content.assignments'.

description.description: Tool description. Pre-fills the tool description in TTM. Required by the TTM authoring guide as one of: this field or role.description.

icon.description: Tool icon as a data URL ('data:image/...;base64,...') or raw base64. Must decode to an image, be <= 40 KB decoded, longest side <= 256 px.

roles.description: Document roles the tool reads/writes. Each role is the contract between the tool and the operator's data structures; keys must stay stable across versions. Infrastructure tools (e.g. the Tool Manager, the dashboard itself) may ship an empty list.

role.description: One document role. At least one of role.description or the tool-level description should exist so TTM can pre-fill a description.

key.description: Stable role identifier. Becomes a key in tool.assignments; downstream tools may rely on it. Do not rename between versions.

name.description: Legacy alias for key (only used if key is absent). Prefer key.

direction.description: Data-flow direction of this role in a toolchain. 'provides' = the tool writes documents of this role; 'consumes' = the tool reads documents of this role written by an upstream tool; 'both' = the tool may do both. Optional; tools that only produce their roles may omit it (default: provides).

description.description: Human-readable description of the role's purpose.

structure.description: Field shape of the role's documents. Enables TTM structure matching/suggestions.

name.description: Legacy alias for key (only used if key is absent). Prefer key.

display.description: Human-readable field label shown in UIs.

displayName.description: Legacy alias for display. Prefer display.

type.description: Field data type. Core types map 1:1 to DocPouch types; aliases are normalised by TTM (see TYPE_COMPATIBILITY).

items.description: For array/list type: the element type (e.g. 'string', or a role key like 'corporateValue').

reference.description: For object type: name of the role (or structure) this field references. Boosts TTM structure matching.
